description: Figure 3 is a donut-style pie chart titled “Stimulus Type” that shows the distribution of input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs in WildChat conversations matched to online articles from two news agencies. The chart contains 10 slices, each labeled with a category name and percentage: Draft/Other (26.4%, shown in red), External News Article (18.1%, green), Press Release (18.7%, orange), Organizational Website (4.9%, purple), Organizational Report (7.7%, light purple), Interview (8.8%, dark blue), Event Posting (6.6%, pink), Intra-agency news article (4.9%, gray), Email (2.7%, yellow), and Social Media Post (1.1%, light gray). The percentages are printed next to the labels around the ring, there is no separate legend, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slices appear arranged roughly from the largest segment near the top-right proceeding around the circle with smaller segments clustered toward the left/top-left.
